summary: Reject invalid projection and unsupported focused output modes before state changes; bound every raw source stdin body.
reason: An error must preserve the previous offline snapshot. Focused commands promise JSON, and raw live POST input needs the same 2 MiB bound as previews.
validated_outcome: Regressions reproduce snapshot replacement, silently accepted output modes and oversized stdin; fixes reject each at the command boundary without source requests or inventory mutation.
